factual_claims.claim: Anthropic released a constitution for its chatbot Claude in early 2026.
The U.S. Constitution is approximately 4,500 words long.
Claude's Constitution is over 30,000 words long.
President Trump banned the U.S. government from using Anthropic in early 2026.
The Future of Life Institute published an open letter calling for a six-month pause on AI training in early 2023.
The Center for AI Safety issued a statement on AI extinction risk in May 2023.
President Biden signed an executive order on AI in November 2023.
